facts.business: Remi Edelstahl Tubulars Limited manufactures stainless steel pipes and tubes for industries such as oil and gas, power, petrochemicals, chemicals, food processing, pharmaceuticals, and defence.
key_risks: Monopolistic raw material supply (nickel) affecting industry
Volatility in nickel prices impacting demand and project viability
Dumping of secondary quality products and imports under FTA
Geo-political disturbances in Middle East affecting capex and consumption
Competition from multinational companies and cost-effective producers
Dependence on imported raw materials and import affairs
Cyclical nature of stainless steel industry
Government import restrictions affecting special grade material availability
